subject: Audit logs and export formats - follow-up from call
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@fincobank.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs and export formats - follow-up from call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier 	6 that was really helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security and compliance team around audit logs and data exports:

- Can you confirm the exact fields available in the access audit logs (who accessed what/when)? Our primary ask is a log that shows: user id/email, resource accessed (model/endpoint), operation (generate/embedding/export), timestamp, client IP, and request id.
- What export formats do you support for bulk export? (CSV, NDJSON, Parquet?) We prefer a schema we can ingest into our internal SIEM.
- Retention and retention policy options: is there a configurable retention window for audit logs (we need at least 1 year for our audit scope)?
- PII handling: do you offer column-level redaction, pseudonymization, or on-export scrubbing to remove customer PII from audit exports?
- Evidence for SOC2 / compliance: can you provide a sample export or proof of process showing an access audit for the production environment (last 90 days)? We will need a secure link to download any artifacts.

Tom and I are aiming to present this to our InfoSec committee next week. If you can provide a short sample export (sanitized) and a one-page summary of the process, that would be ideal.

Cheers,
Alice Turner
InfoSec Lead, FincoBank

---

Note: attaching a redacted example would be fine; we just need the schema and a short explanation of how you guarantee integrity (checksums, signed artifacts, access controls).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@fincobank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs and export formats - follow-up from call

Hi Alice 	6 great to talk earlier, and thanks for the clear list. Recap and next steps below.

Recap of what Redwood can provide today:
- Audit log fields: user_id/email, service/endpoint, model_id, operation_type, timestamp (ISO8601 UTC), client_ip, request_id, response_size, and any policy/evaluation flags.
- Export formats: CSV, NDJSON, and Parquet. Exports can be streamed to S3 (preferred), pushed to an SFTP endpoint, or made available as a signed HTTPS download for a limited window.
- Retention: configurable per-account retention. Default retention is 90 days; we support extending to 365 days (and longer via reserved retention add-on).
- PII handling: we support on-export pseudonymization (hashing of specified fields), column redaction, and policy-based redaction rules. We also support generating a sanitized sample where identifiers are deterministic-hashed so you can map patterns without exposing raw PII.
- Evidence: we can provide a sanitized sample export of production audit logs (sample of last 90 days) plus our SOC 2 attestation. We will provide checksums (SHA256) for exported artifacts and log export audit entries.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a small schema CSV (audit_log_schema.csv) that lists available fields and types. I also attached a redacted sample (audit_log_sample.csv) to show format.
2) Aditya (cc'd) will provide specifics about export workflow (S3 presigned URL, SFTP) and the options for retention and redaction.
3) If you confirm preferred export format and delivery method, we can produce a sanitized extract and a short one-page process summary for your InfoSec committee by Tue 31 Mar.

Let me know if that timeline works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: audit_log_schema.csv (stub), audit_log_sample.csv (sanitized stub), soc2_attestation_redwood.pdf (attestation stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@fincobank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs and export formats - follow-up from call

Hi Alice 	6 adding a few technical details so you have everything for the committee: 

1) Export / delivery options:
   - S3 export: we can provision per-export presigned URLs with TLS and provide SHA256 checksums. Exports can be delivered as CSV, NDJSON, or Parquet. Parquet is compact and recommended for large volumes.
   - SFTP: we support secure SFTP delivery to a customer-managed endpoint.
   - HTTPS signed download: short-lived signed URL for manual download.

2) Retention and log store:
   - Default account retention: 90 days.
   - Extended retention: configurable up to 3 years via policy (logged as a billing/contract add-on).
   - Immutable export snapshots: we can write exports to a read-only S3 path (bucket/object versioning recommended) and include an export event in the audit trail.

3) PII handling and redaction:
   - Column redaction rules: you can specify which fields to redact on-export.
   - Pseudonymization: deterministic hashing with per-tenant salt (managed by your KMS or Redwood KMS integration) so hashed values are consistent but not reversible.
   - On-request scrubbing: we can drop request/response payload fields matching a configured regex (e.g., SSN, email) during export.

4) Evidence & integrity:
   - We will include an export manifest (JSONL) that lists object names, record counts, export start/end timestamps, and SHA256 checksums.
   - For your compliance review we can provide a sanitized 7	614 day sample and the manifest; for a full 90-day extract we can follow your delivery preference.

If you confirm: (a) preferred format (CSV/NDJSON/Parquet), (b) delivery method (S3 presigned / SFTP / signed URL), and (c) whether you want deterministic pseudonymization or full redaction, we will schedule the export and get the manifest to you.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs and export formats - follow-up from call

Thanks Marissa and Aditya 	6 this is exactly what we needed. Quick answers from our side:

- Preferred format: Parquet for the full export, and CSV sample for quick review.
- Delivery: S3 presigned URLs are preferred; we will provide a customer-managed bucket or accept a Redwood presigned link if you recommend it.
- PII handling: deterministic pseudonymization with tenant-specific salt would be ideal so we can correlate activity without exposing raw identifiers.

Request for evidence: can you provide the sanitized 14-day sample (CSV) and the Parquet full-export manifest for the last 90 days by Tue 31 Mar? For the compliance packet we will also need:
- Copy of export manifest (with checksums).
- A one-page summary of the export process and controls (who can request exports, approval flow, where artifacts are stored).
- The SOC2 attestation (PDF) 	6 if the attestation is redacted in any way, please note the reason.

If you can upload the artifacts to the shared Drive link you included or send presigned S3 links, we'll pull them into our evidence tracker and run a quick integrity check. After we review the sample, we may request a brief 30-minute follow-up to clarify any mapping questions.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice Turner
InfoSec Lead, FincoBank
